main_text.p: ex Procopij,Iornădis,Marcellini,Pauli Diaconi,& aliorū scriptis intelligūtur:ut perspicuū cuiuis esse possit, falsum esse quod Papæ contendunt, maio-res suos vel in Italia, vel in urbe Roma dominatum ex Constantini donatione obtinuisse: cum is dominatus anno demum Christianæ salutis o-ctingentesimo initium habuerit, ex Pipini & Caroli magni liberalitate, qui Exarchatu Lögobardis ereptū una cum urbe Roma Papę Stephano secundo donarūt:ut Platina, Volaterranus,& alij omnes te-statur.sed præsertim Sabellicus Ennead.8.libr.8.ubi præter cæteros adscribit, Constantinum quartum Orientis Imp. legatos ad Pipinum in Italiam mi-sisse,qui ab eo peterēt,ut Rauennā & cętera Exar-chatus loca suo Imperatori restituēda curaret.quip-pe,quæ Imperii essent(sic loquitur Sabellicus)nō aut Pōtificis.Neque se Pipinus Costantino aut cuiquā homi-nū prætērquā Ecclesiæ Romanæ militare, eōque cōsilio se arma indūisse,ut Apostolicā sedem ab omniū mortalium iniuria vindicaret:utque Rauennam & quicquid Longobardi vi & armis subegissent, Romanæ subiiceret Ecclesiæ. Ita Græci oratores re infecta domum redierunt. Hæc Sabellicus. Platina autē Exarchatu Astulpho Longobardo ereptum,& Papę Stephano traditum subiungit, anno DCCLVI. simulque Imperatoris nomen Carolo magno Pipini filio tribuisse, quod Imperatores Orientis ægrè per ea tepora tuebātur, hoc est,anno DCCCI[?].qua de re Albert° Krantzius in Saxon.lib.2.c.1.sic scribit: Tribuunt nonnulli Constātino Magno donationem illā Italiæ,& Germaniæ & nescio quarum provinciarum Ecclesiæ Romanæ factam:de qua ipsi viderint.Carolus erat,qui ex victoria Lögobar-

page.notes: The number for the year of Krantz's date is printed with a reversed-C form (1ↃCCCI); I read it as DCCCI with the leading mark uncertain, so it is marked [?]. "Albert°" carries a small superscript mark as printed. Printing spelling such as "Pōtificis", "Pipinus" and "ereptū" is left as printed. The top line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The text ends on a hyphenated word that continues on the next page.
